findings.rule: security-baseline rule 7 as applied in spec.md (runtime calls only the three Binance hosts); spec R12 timeouts
findings.summary: build_opener keeps urllib's default redirect and plain-HTTP handlers, so a 3xx from a Binance host would be followed to any host, including over http:// with no timeout, which defeats the 'only the three Binance hosts' and 10 s/60 s timeout assumptions; unlikely in practice (doubt: Binance does not redirect these paths today).

findings.rule: spec.md Design § Parameters (validated before any URL or path is built)
findings.summary: parse_date returns a datetime unchanged (datetime subclasses date), so load_klines(..., start=datetime(...)) fails with a bare TypeError from `end_day > today` instead of an InvalidRequestError or a value normalised with .date().
